summary: Brookfield Finance Inc. and Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Fourteenth Supplemental Indenture dated September 23, 2026, with Computershare Trust Company of Canada as trustee, establishing a new series of 5.650% Notes due 2031 under the 2016 base indenture. The filing is an ordinary debt issuance supplemental indenture, not a special situation. It includes change-of-control put mechanics tied to a Below Investment Grade Rating Event within a 60-day window and additional-amounts covenants. No equity stake, price per share, premium, or equity event is involved; monitor rate and covenant terms only.
